en.headline: Tourist video shows taxi fare jump after Disneyland trip
en.dek: A passenger said a meter reading of about HK$144.50 from Disneyland to Tsuen Wan West became HK$376 after the driver cited a bridge fee; Lantau Link tolls have been waived since 2020.
body: A visitor posted a cabin video early on Monday alleging that a red urban taxi from Hong Kong Disneyland to Nina Hotel Tsuen Wan West charged HK$376 after the meter had shown about HK$144.50 at the drop-off.

In the recording circulated by local outlets, the driver stopped the meter at the hotel, pressed buttons on the unit, and told the passenger the extra sum was a bridge fee for leaving Disneyland, saying the charge applied on outbound trips but not on the way in. The passenger paid about HK$400 in cash and later said the extra amount was more than HK$230.

The Transport Department has waived Lantau Link tolls since 27 December 2020. Police told Star Headline they had received no overcharging complaint in Tsuen Wan on 29 or 30 August. The poster said a complaint had been lodged with New Territories South traffic police. The clip does not state the date of the ride.
Taxi overcharging of visitors is a recurring enforcement issue. The clip has not been independently authenticated by authorities, and no arrest has been announced.

zh.headline: 遊客指迪士尼的士以過橋費將車資加至376元
zh.dek: 短片顯示由樂園往荃灣西如心酒店，咪錶約144.5元後司機稱要過橋費，最終收376元；青嶼幹線已於2020年底起豁免收費。
body: 周一早上有遊客在社交平台發佈車廂短片，指由香港迪士尼樂園乘坐紅色市區的士往荃灣西如心酒店，到達時咪錶顯示約144.5元，其後司機操作咪錶並表示要收取過橋費，車資變成376元。
短片中乘客質疑收費，司機稱由樂園出市區要過橋，入園則不用，又說由該處開出的的士都要付。乘客以約400元現金付款，其後指被多收逾230元。
運輸署資料顯示，青嶼幹線由2020年12月27日零時起豁免收費。《星島頭條》引述警方回覆，指29及30日荃灣區並無接獲濫收車資投訴。發片人稱已向新界南交通部投訴備案。片段沒有交代事發日期。
的士向旅客濫收車資屬警方及運輸署長期執法項目。目前未有當局公開核實該段短片，亦未公布有人被捕。
